units.rawText: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.
units.displayText: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.

spans.text: The Cyclopes Sector, at the former site of the quarantine wall – Gin's Bar.

units.rawText: I'll leave her to you, then. Hurry up and leave Cyclopes. I don't have the time to keep taking care of you.
units.displayText: I'll leave her to you, then. Hurry up and leave Cyclopes. I don't have the time to keep taking care of you.

spans.text: I'll leave her to you, then. Hurry up and leave Cyclopes. I don't have the time to keep taking care of you.

units.rawText: You too, Gin. Pick another building to set up shop. The bar's been hit by accident several times now. There's no guarantee as to when it'll collapse.
units.displayText: You too, Gin. Pick another building to set up shop. The bar's been hit by accident several times now. There's no guarantee as to when it'll collapse.

spans.text: You too, Gin. Pick another building to set up shop. The bar's been hit by accident several times now. There's no guarantee as to when it'll collapse.

units.rawText: Thank you for the reminder, Nameless.
units.displayText: Thank you for the reminder, Nameless.

spans.text: Thank you for the reminder, Nameless.

units.rawText: The agent called Nameless waves it off and leaves the bar.
units.displayText: The agent called Nameless waves it off and leaves the bar.

spans.text: The agent called Nameless waves it off and leaves the bar.

units.rawText: I'm Zangyin, a Doll from the Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: I'm Zangyin, a Doll from the Cloud Sector.

spans.text: I'm Zangyin, a Doll from the Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Nice to meet you. I'm Gin of the Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: Nice to meet you. I'm Gin of the Cloud Sector.

spans.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Gin of the Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Miss Zangyin, would you like a cocktail? Strong liquor suits the Cyclopes Sector very well.
units.displayText: Miss Zangyin, would you like a cocktail? Strong liquor suits the Cyclopes Sector very well.

spans.text: Miss Zangyin, would you like a cocktail? Strong liquor suits the Cyclopes Sector very well.

units.rawText: I'll pass.
units.displayText: I'll pass.

spans.text: I'll pass.

units.rawText: Rather, I'm more interested in why someone is using etiquette from the British Middle Ages in the 2060s.
units.displayText: Rather, I'm more interested in why someone is using etiquette from the British Middle Ages in the 2060s.

spans.text: Rather, I'm more interested in why someone is using etiquette from the British Middle Ages in the 2060s.

units.rawText: The first order I received after being rolled out was to "maintain the elegance of an English gentleman regardless of circumstances."
units.displayText: The first order I received after being rolled out was to "maintain the elegance of an English gentleman regardless of circumstances."

spans.text: The first order I received after being rolled out was to "maintain the elegance of an English gentleman regardless of circumstances."

units.rawText: You seem very familiar with such etiquette, seeing how accurate you were.
units.displayText: You seem very familiar with such etiquette, seeing how accurate you were.

spans.text: You seem very familiar with such etiquette, seeing how accurate you were.

units.rawText: Well, that IS my profession, after all. So, are you the contact that agent was talking about when he was telling me I would be "better off elsewhere"?
units.displayText: Well, that IS my profession, after all. So, are you the contact that agent was talking about when he was telling me I would be "better off elsewhere"?

spans.text: Well, that IS my profession, after all. So, are you the contact that agent was talking about when he was telling me I would be "better off elsewhere"?

units.rawText: Indeed, I am.
units.displayText: Indeed, I am.

spans.text: Indeed, I am.

units.rawText: The Oasis is the Professor's private sector, and it takes in the Dolls from the Cloud Sector who were lost and scattered throughout Magrasea.
units.displayText: The Oasis is the Professor's private sector, and it takes in the Dolls from the Cloud Sector who were lost and scattered throughout Magrasea.

spans.text: The Oasis is the Professor's private sector, and it takes in the Dolls from the Cloud Sector who were lost and scattered throughout Magrasea.

units.rawText: A personal sector... Is it safe there? Cyclopes is a major Svarog sector, and it's got more holes in it than a colander right now.
units.displayText: A personal sector... Is it safe there? Cyclopes is a major Svarog sector, and it's got more holes in it than a colander right now.

spans.text: A personal sector... Is it safe there? Cyclopes is a major Svarog sector, and it's got more holes in it than a colander right now.

units.rawText: Do you not think that point is adequately proven by the fact that I can be dispatched to a place like this as an external supporter?
units.displayText: Do you not think that point is adequately proven by the fact that I can be dispatched to a place like this as an external supporter?

spans.text: Do you not think that point is adequately proven by the fact that I can be dispatched to a place like this as an external supporter?

units.rawText: ...That kind of makes sense.
units.displayText: ...That kind of makes sense.

spans.text: ...That kind of makes sense.

units.rawText: Another question. Is there someone in the Oasis called Nora?
units.displayText: Another question. Is there someone in the Oasis called Nora?

spans.text: Another question. Is there someone in the Oasis called Nora?

units.rawText: One of Nora's newly-published novels just hit the shelves in the Oasis a few days ago.
units.displayText: One of Nora's newly-published novels just hit the shelves in the Oasis a few days ago.

spans.text: One of Nora's newly-published novels just hit the shelves in the Oasis a few days ago.

units.rawText: Tsk... What the hell, was I the unlucky one in the end?
units.displayText: Tsk... What the hell, was I the unlucky one in the end?

spans.text: Tsk... What the hell, was I the unlucky one in the end?

units.rawText: Zangyin pouts, but her expression visibly softens.
units.displayText: Zangyin pouts, but her expression visibly softens.

spans.text: Zangyin pouts, but her expression visibly softens.

units.rawText: She drinks the ice water Gin offers her and looks outside the bar window.
units.displayText: She drinks the ice water Gin offers her and looks outside the bar window.

spans.text: She drinks the ice water Gin offers her and looks outside the bar window.

units.rawText: The ruins of the wall stand tall under the darkened sky.
units.displayText: The ruins of the wall stand tall under the darkened sky.

spans.text: The ruins of the wall stand tall under the darkened sky.

units.rawText: Bullet marks and noxious black smoke stains mark its surface. Silent agents pass through the gap in it with thousand-yard stares on their faces.
units.displayText: Bullet marks and noxious black smoke stains mark its surface. Silent agents pass through the gap in it with thousand-yard stares on their faces.

spans.text: Bullet marks and noxious black smoke stains mark its surface. Silent agents pass through the gap in it with thousand-yard stares on their faces.

units.rawText: (War DOES wipe away a lot of things.)
units.displayText: War DOES wipe away a lot of things.

spans.text: War DOES wipe away a lot of things.

units.rawText: (To collect and preserve the last of their data... right? Old man, I still can't accept your actions even now.)
units.displayText: To collect and preserve the last of their data... right? Old man, I still can't accept your actions even now.

spans.text: To collect and preserve the last of their data... right? Old man, I still can't accept your actions even now.

units.rawText: Zangyin places the ice water on the table. The clear, cool sensation has banished some of the confusion in the neural cloud. The images from her visual systems overlap once again with the scenes from her memory.
units.displayText: Zangyin places the ice water on the table. The clear, cool sensation has banished some of the confusion in the neural cloud. The images from her visual systems overlap once again with the scenes from her memory.

spans.text: Zangyin places the ice water on the table. The clear, cool sensation has banished some of the confusion in the neural cloud. The images from her visual systems overlap once again with the scenes from her memory.

units.rawText: (...Still, I'll be able to understand you better if I see a little more, right?)
units.displayText: ...Still, I'll be able to understand you better if I see a little more, right?

spans.text: ...Still, I'll be able to understand you better if I see a little more, right?

units.rawText: Thank you for the help you've given Nora and myself. However, I can't go to the Oasis at the moment.
units.displayText: Thank you for the help you've given Nora and myself. However, I can't go to the Oasis at the moment.

spans.text: Thank you for the help you've given Nora and myself. However, I can't go to the Oasis at the moment.

units.rawText: I still have something I need to do in Cyclopes, and I plan to help with the post-battle reconstruction here.
units.displayText: I still have something I need to do in Cyclopes, and I plan to help with the post-battle reconstruction here.

spans.text: I still have something I need to do in Cyclopes, and I plan to help with the post-battle reconstruction here.

units.rawText: So don't tell the Professor I'm here... Wait a minute, what are you doing?
units.displayText: So don't tell the Professor I'm here... Wait a minute, what are you doing?

spans.text: So don't tell the Professor I'm here... Wait a minute, what are you doing?

units.rawText: Gin's hands stop moving and he moves his screen over, in front of Zangyin's eyes.
units.displayText: Gin's hands stop moving and he moves his screen over, in front of Zangyin's eyes.

spans.text: Gin's hands stop moving and he moves his screen over, in front of Zangyin's eyes.

units.rawText: [Lost Doll Contact Registration Reply: Serial Number 2-17—Zangyin.]
units.displayText: [Lost Doll Contact Registration Reply: Serial Number 2-17—Zangyin.]

spans.text: [Lost Doll Contact Registration Reply: Serial Number 2-17—Zangyin.]

units.rawText: The Professor has already received news of you. This is the Oasis' response. You may proceed to the Oasis any time you wish.
units.displayText: The Professor has already received news of you. This is the Oasis' response. You may proceed to the Oasis any time you wish.

spans.text: The Professor has already received news of you. This is the Oasis' response. You may proceed to the Oasis any time you wish.

units.rawText: You're being a little TOO quick, don't you think? Couldn't you at least hear me out first?
units.displayText: You're being a little TOO quick, don't you think? Couldn't you at least hear me out first?

spans.text: You're being a little TOO quick, don't you think? Couldn't you at least hear me out first?

units.rawText: That's my job.
units.displayText: That's my job.

spans.text: That's my job.

units.rawText: Why, you! Are you a barkeep or an electronic watchdog!?
units.displayText: Why, you! Are you a barkeep or an electronic watchdog!?
